newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Technically looking weak and cash may have topped but still some support.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Carryover sell stops likely but index at new high and corn called lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Steady to lower live calls but pork products look strong. Report later today.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Hog slaughter running above year ago but product firm and Cold Storage report may show stocks at or near record low.
